  proc=subprocess.Popen(argv,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr)
  while proc.poll() is None:
   try:proc.wait(timeout=30)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:print(json.dumps({'running':name,'pid':proc.pid,'seconds':round(time.monotonic()-start)}),flush=True)
 result={'id':name,'cwd':str(cwd),'argv':argv,'candidate':candidate,'startedAt':started,'durationSeconds':round(time.monotonic()-start,3),'exitCode':proc.returncode,'expectedExitCode':1 if name in ('loc','runtime-source') else 0,'afterDirty':bool(git('status','--porcelain'))}
 for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
  p=OUT/(name+'.'+stream+'.txt');raw=p.read_bytes();result[stream]={'path':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'text':raw.decode('utf-8')}
 results.append(result)
 (OUT/'gates.json').write_text(json.dumps({'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-convergence','candidate':candidate,'gates':results},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
 print(json.dumps({'id':name,'exitCode':proc.returncode,'seconds':result['durationSeconds'],'afterDirty':result['afterDirty']}),flush=True)
 assert not result['afterDirty']
raise SystemExit(int(any(r['exitCode']!=r['expectedExitCode'] for r in results)))

import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(r'C:\Users\27933\.codex\worktrees\architecture-convergence-recovered\ClawX')
RUN=Path(__file__).parent
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],cwd=ROOT)
candidate=git('rev-parse','HEAD').decode().strip()
tree={}
for record in git('ls-tree','-r','-z','HEAD').split(b'\0'):
 if not record:continue
 meta,path=record.split(b'\t',1);tree[path.decode()]=meta.split()[2].decode()
bindings=[]
for label,file,prefix in [('application','app-graph.json',''),('runtime','runtime-graph.json','openclaw_runtime/')]:
 graph=json.loads((RUN/file).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
 assert not graph['components']
 exact=normalized=0
 for source in graph['sourceHashes']:
  path=prefix+source['file'];raw=(ROOT/path).read_bytes()
  assert sha(raw)==source['sha256'],path
  def blob(b):return hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(b)).encode()+b'\0'+b).hexdigest()
  if blob(raw)==tree[path]:exact+=1
  else:
   assert blob(raw.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n'))==tree[path],path
   normalized+=1
 bindings.append({'scope':label,'files':len(graph['sourceHashes']),'exactBytes':exact,'lineEndingOnly':normalized,'mismatches':0,'originalGraphSha256':sha((RUN/file).read_bytes())})
old=json.loads((ROOT/'harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-runtime-cycles/runtime-source-residual.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
loc=(RUN/'candidate/loc.stdout.txt').read_bytes()
assert sha(loc)==old['loc']['candidateStdoutSha256']
pack_checks=[]
for relative in ['harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-admission-ast','harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-small-cycles','harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-runtime-cycles','harness/specs/fixtures/architecture-authority-convergence/acceptance']:
 folder=ROOT/relative;files=[]
 for line in (folder/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
  digest,name=line.split('  ',1)
  target=ROOT/name if name.startswith(relative+'/') else folder/name
  assert target.resolve().is_relative_to(folder.resolve())
  assert sha(target.read_bytes())==digest,name
  files.append(name)
 pack_checks.append({'path':relative,'hashesVerified':len(files)})
protected=['electron','src','openclaw_runtime','shared/dcs/prod-flags-catalog.ts','shared/types/workspace.ts','shared/permission-effect-contract.ts','docs/dev/default-config-matrix.md','package.json','pnpm-lock.yaml']
assert not git('diff','3a362590d','HEAD','--',*protected).strip()
assert not git('diff','a80f06b17','HEAD','--','harness/specs/fixtures/ontology-lite-existing-contracts/final','harness/specs/fixtures/ontology-lite-existing-contracts/provenance').strip()
result={'driven_by':'agent','actor':'codex-architecture-convergence','candidate':candidate,'sourceBindings':bindings,'previousPacks':pack_checks,'inheritedLocStdoutIdentical':True,'inheritedLocSha256':sha(loc),'protectedPathsUnchanged':protected,'historicalSemanticPacksUnchanged':True,'method':'SHA256 readback plus Git blob SHA1 against current commit tree; CRLF-only difference is classified, never silently treated as raw equality.'}
(RUN/'source-readback.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False))
